summary: Re-tested the complete Custodian prototype across public APIs and desktop/mobile browser journeys; all required flows passed, including the repaired mobile hamburger.
action_items: Consider adding visible error states for failed experience/profile API requests instead of leaving the loading message indefinitely.
critical_code_review_comments: Detail and custodian profile fetches still have no catch/error state; an API failure can leave the user on a permanent loading screen.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; six illustrative in-memory experiences were used. Booking confirmation/payment and legacy persistence are MOCKED by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested API and UI journeys passed: six cards, category filters, Mystery Local routing, detail settings, pending booking, legacy form, custodian profile, passport, six dashboard toggles, calendar, mobile menu aria-expanded/link visibility, responsive overflow, and console-error checks. Production yarn build also passed.
rca of the issue: The prior inert mobile menu regression is resolved: Shell now tracks menuOpen, toggles aria-expanded, and conditionally exposes Discover, My passport, and For custodians links.
